title: OpenAI wants your medical records, and says its AI is ‘better than clinician level’

content_html:
OpenAI wants to be in the room for your next diagnosis. On Thursday it began rolling out ChatGPT Health to every logged-in US adult.

The chatbot can now connect to your Apple Health data and medical records, the company said. It can then draw on them in any conversation. More than 300 million people already ask ChatGPT health questions each week.

Now it wants their lab results, medications and visit notes too.

The pitch came with a bold claim. OpenAI’s vice-president of health product, Ashley Alexander, made it plainly. Its models “are now capable of reasoning at levels that are better than clinician level,” she said, per The Verge.

Pressed on it, the company’s health lead Karan Singhal quickly softened the line. He would “temper” that, he said, though “individual studies” pointed that way. The headline claim did not survive the first follow-up question.

What it does

The feature moves health out of a side tab and into the main chat. OpenAI tested a dedicated health space earlier this year, but more than 70% of health chats happened outside it, so it merged the two.

Connect Apple Health, One Medical, Function Health or a supported US hospital system. ChatGPT can then compare a new lab result with old ones. It can summarise what changed since your last visit, or weigh a dietary restriction when suggesting a recipe. It asks permission before using the data.

Free users get GPT-5.5 Instant. Paying users get GPT-5.6 Sol, which OpenAI calls its “strongest model yet for health”.

OpenAI leaned hard on privacy. Connected records, Apple Health data and the chats that use them are not used to train its models or target ads, it said, whatever your other settings.

Everything is encrypted, you can revoke access, and disconnected data is deleted within 30 days. Even so, handing a chatbot your medical history is a leap. Critics see where it leads.

“The interesting thing to me is the surveillance ratchet,” one wrote, imagining an AI that wants a camera, a microphone, and eventually your pheromones.

Awkward timing

The launch could hardly be worse timed. Days earlier, a Florida pastor sued OpenAI, claiming ChatGPT gave him “extremely dangerous medical recommendations” that led him to delay care for a near-fatal pulmonary embolism.

OpenAI’s own disclaimer concedes the bot “can still make mistakes” and does not replace a doctor. Its heavy reliance on Apple Health is awkward, too, given OpenAI is fighting Apple in court over trade secrets.

None of this is slowing the march of AI into medicine, from note-taking to diagnosis. The upside is real. People juggling scattered records and overlapping conditions may finally see the whole picture.

The risk is just as real. A confident chatbot, trusted with the most sensitive data there is, is right most of the time and wrong when it matters most. OpenAI says its models keep improving. In the same breath, it says to check anything important with a real doctor.

content_html_zh:
OpenAI 希望为您提供下一次诊断。 周四，它开始向每位登录的美国成年人推出 ChatGPT Health。

该公司表示，聊天机器人现在可以连接到您的苹果健康数据和医疗记录。 然后它可以在任何对话中利用它们。 每周已有超过 3 亿人询问 ChatGPT 健康问题。

现在它还想要他们的实验室结果、药物和就诊记录。

此次推介会提出了一个大胆的主张。 OpenAI 健康产品副总裁 Ashley Alexander 明确表示。 据 The Verge 报道，她表示，其模型“现在能够以比临床医生水平更好的推理水平”。

在这方面的压力下，该公司的健康主管卡兰·辛哈尔(Karan Singhal)很快软化了立场。 他说，他会“缓和”这一点，尽管“个人研究”表明了这一点。 头条新闻在第一个后续问题中未能幸存。

欧盟科技的💜

来自欧盟科技界的最新传言、我们明智的创始人鲍里斯的故事，以及一些值得怀疑的人工智能艺术。 每周都会免费发送到您的收件箱中。 立即注册！

它的作用

该功能将健康状况从侧选项卡移至主聊天中。 OpenAI 今年早些时候测试了一个专门的健康空间，但超过 70% 的健康聊天发生在该空间之外，因此它将两者合并。

连接 Apple Health、One Medical、Function Health 或受支持的美国医院系统。 然后 ChatGPT 可以将新的实验室结果与旧的结果进行比较。 它可以总结自您上次访问以来发生的变化，或者在建议食谱时权衡饮食限制。 它在使用数据之前请求许可。

免费用户可获得 GPT-5.5 Instant。 付费用户可以获得 GPT-5.6 Sol，OpenAI 称之为“迄今为止最强大的健康模型”。

OpenAI 非常注重隐私。 它说，无论你的其他设置如何，连接的记录、苹果健康数据以及使用它们的聊天都不会用于训练其模型或定位广告。

一切都经过加密，您可以撤销访问，并且断开连接的数据将在 30 天内删除。 即便如此，向聊天机器人提供你的病史仍然是一个飞跃。 批评家们看到了它的走向。

“对我来说，有趣的是监视棘轮，”其中一位写道，想象一个人工智能需要一个摄像头、一个麦克风，最终需要你的信息素。

尴尬的时机

此次发射的时机再糟糕不过了。 几天前，佛罗里达州的一位牧师起诉 OpenAI，声称 ChatGPT 给了他“极其危险的医疗建议”，导致他推迟了对几乎致命的肺栓塞的治疗。

OpenAI 自己的免责声明承认机器人“仍然会犯错误”，并且不会取代医生。 鉴于 OpenAI 正在法庭上就商业机密与苹果公司进行斗争，它对 Apple Health 的严重依赖也很尴尬。

所有这些都没有减缓人工智能从记录到诊断的医学领域的发展。 好处是真实的。 人们在分散的记录和重叠的条件之间周旋，最终可能会看到全貌。

风险同样真实存在。 一个自信的聊天机器人，拥有最敏感的数据，在大多数时候都是正确的，而在最重要的时候却是错误的。 OpenAI 表示其模型不断改进。 同时，它还说要向真正的医生检查任何重要的事情。
